t: And on the Sabbath eve, when the first day of the week dawns, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

o: Y he aquí, fue hecho un gran terremoto: porque el ángel del Señor, descendiendo del cielo y llegando, había revuelto la piedra, y estaba sentado sobre ella.
t: And behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came, and had rolled back the stone, and was sitting on it.

o: Y su aspecto era como un relámpago, y su vestido blanco como la nieve.
t: And his appearance was like lightning, and his garment white as snow.

o: Y de miedo de él los guardas se asombraron, y fueron vueltos como muertos.
t: And the guards were terrified by him, and became as if dead.

o: Y respondiendo el ángel, dijo a las mujeres: No temáis vosotras; porque yo sé que buscáis a Jesús, que fue crucificado.
t: And the angel answered and said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified."

o: No está aquí; porque ha resucitado, como dijo. Venid, ved el lugar donde fue puesto el Señor.
t: He is not here, for he has risen, just as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

o: E id presto, decid a sus discípulos que ha resucitado de los muertos: y he aquí va delante de vosotros a Galilea; allí le veréis; he aquí, os lo he dicho.
t: And go quickly and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead; and behold, he is going before you to Galilee; there you will see him. Behold, I have told you."

o: Entonces ellas, saliendo del sepulcro con temor y gran gozo, fueron corriendo a dar las nuevas a sus discípulos. Y mientras iban a dar las nuevas a sus discípulos,
t: Then the women went out from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring the news to his disciples. And while they were going to bring the news to his disciples,

o: He aquí, Jesús les sale al encuentro, diciendo: Salve. Y ellas se llegaron y abrazaron sus pies, y le adoraron.
t: behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Greetings." And they came up to him and embraced his feet and worshiped him.

o: Entonces Jesús les dice: No temáis: id, dad las nuevas a mis hermanos, para que vayan a Galilea, y allí me verán.
t: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers that they should go to Galilee, and there they will see me."

o: Y yendo ellas, he aquí unos de la guardia vinieron a la ciudad, y dieron aviso a los príncipes de los sacerdotes de todas las cosas que habían acontecido.
t: And as the women were going away, behold, some of the guard came into the city and told the chief priests all that had happened.

o: Y juntados con los ancianos, y habido consejo, dieron mucho dinero a los soldados,
t: And when they had assembled with the elders and had held a council, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

o: Diciendo: Decid: Sus discípulos vinieron de noche, y le hurtaron, durmiendo nosotros.
t: saying, "Tell people this: His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were sleeping."

o: Y si esto fuere oído del presidente, nosotros le persuadiremos, y os haremos seguros.
t: And if this is heard before the governor, we will persuade him and keep you safe.

o: Y ellos, tomando el dinero, hicieron como estaban instruídos: y este dicho fue divulgado entre los Judíos hasta el día de hoy.
t: And they took the money and did as they were instructed; and this story has been spread among the Jews to this very day.

o: Mas los once discípulos se fueron a Galilea, al monte donde Jesús les había ordenado.
t: But the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had commanded them.

o: Y como le vieron, le adoraron: mas algunos dudaban.
t: And when they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

o: Y llegando Jesús, les habló, diciendo: Toda potestad me es dada en el cielo y en la tierra.
t: And when Jesus came, he spoke to them, saying, "All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth."

o: Por tanto, id, y doctrinad a todos los Gentiles, bautizándolos en el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo:
t: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

o: Enseñándoles que guarden todas las cosas que os he mandado: y he aquí, yo estoy con vosotros todos los días, hasta el fin del mundo. Amén.
t: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you; and behold, I am with you all the days, to the very end of the world. Amen."
